The confidentiality and use restrictions with respect to Proprietary and Confidential Information disclosed prior to termination shall survive for a period of two (2) years after the termination.

arguments.label: Contradiction
arguments.explanation: Span 19 requires Recipient to return or destroy all Information and retain no copies, contradicting the hypothesis that some Confidential Information may be retained.
